question:
The line chart given below shows the production of bike and truck by five companies L, M, N, O and P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/830d87432b6fd07bf8180ddf8f92d31f4a16c905ffc88da2d4f865004b27c826.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The ratio of production of bike to the production of truck by company M are 7 ∶ 4.

II. The difference between average of production of bike and truck by all companies is 10.
solution:
**Calculation:**

Production of bike by company M = 350

Production of truck by company M = 200

I. The ratio of production of bike to the production of truck by company M are 7 : 4.

Statement I is correct.

Average production of bike by all companies = (600 + 350 + 400 + 150 + 200)/5 = 1700/5 = 340
